infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Juno's voice agent listens through the microphone only while it is awake, after you draw a clockwise circle.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Juno uses the camera only while you have it open, to tell you what is in front of you, help you aim, and take photos you choose to post.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Juno reads your photos only when you choose from them, to describe each one to you and post the one you pick.
